annotation.justification: The clause provides a clear requirement: an endpoint must retain old keys until it has successfully unprotected a packet sent using the new keys. There is no ambiguity in the language, as it specifies a concrete condition (successful unprotection of a packet using new keys) that must be met before old keys can be discarded. This condition is unambiguous and does not allow for multiple materially different interpretations.
